articles.title: The Sandwiches Revolt: The Uprising Review
articles.description: The Uprising is Paul Greengrass's newest action film. It dramatises the 1381 Peasants revolt, and includes the two leaders of the revolt, Wat Tyler (Cosmo Jarvis) and John Ball (Jamie Bell). Alongside Jarvis and Bell, Andrew Garfield plays the main character, Ploughman, a man who is so tired of the class struggle that he kills a man due to his clear rage against those who exploit those like him. While this movie is indicative of the times we're in, does it really do enough to bring home the point? The post The Sandwiches Revolt: The Uprising Review appeared first on Impact Magazine.
